runHistory.reason: All correction triangle edges are conformingly subdivided below one degree and radial-clearance validated; the Barents view uses the corrected transformed center at the supported 1.5 regional boundary.

The integrated make gate-full browser phase passed 15/17 and exposed two failures: a real exact-checkpoint withheld-state race, and an unsupported-age assertion that still used 720 Ma after the Cao domain expanded to 1800 Ma.
runHistory.recovery: The race now guards stale prepare failures, withholds stale overlays/anchors/picking, and retargets current source markers; the unsupported test now probes 2200 Ma.

runHistory.reason: The frozen integrated production build passed preflight hashes and routing, every prospective hardware stop, three continuous scrub comparisons, two forced-WebGL2 checks, three older-domain smokes, and nine paired captures.

conformingGeometryEvidence.method: Conforming shared-edge midpoint bisection to at most one degree followed by exact closest-point radial-clearance validation after float32 encoding.

conclusion: The frozen integrated v0.1.4 build passes the prewritten cold-ready, cadence, backend, continuous-scrub, geometry, byte, domain, and capture stops on Apple M4 Metal hardware. The first integrated full-gate attempt correctly exposed two browser failures; focused recovery, a deliberate mutation, and the final 118-test deterministic gate verify their disposition. No concrete release defect remains in the reviewed candidate.

preRebaseStopRules.coldReady: Reject when candidate median exceeds baseline median by more than max(250 ms, 20%).
preRebaseStopRules.relativeCadence: Reject when candidate steady cadence is below 90% of baseline.
preRebaseStopRules.absoluteCadence: Reject production readiness below 30 fps, equivalent to frame-time p50 above 33.33 ms.
preRebaseStopRules.landGeometry: Reject above 180000 land vertices or 240000 land triangles.
preRebaseStopRules.aggregateGeometry: Reject above 190000 aggregate vertices or 246000 foundation-triangle plus country-line primitives.
preRebaseStopRules.aggregateDefinition: Aggregate vertices are foundation vertices plus renderer-reported country-line vertices; aggregate primitives are foundation triangles plus renderer-reported country-line segments.
preRebaseStopRules.aggregateRevision: The prior 241000-primitive bound is retained with the rejected visual candidate. The 246000 bound was approved before final measurement from quantified conforming-subdivision counts; cold, cadence, land-geometry, and byte guards were unchanged.

stopRules.coldReady: Reject when candidate median exceeds control median by more than max(250 ms, 20%).
stopRules.relativeCadence: Reject when candidate cadence is below 90% of control cadence.
stopRules.absoluteCadence: Reject when candidate frame-time p50 exceeds 33.33 ms.
stopRules.spatialGeometry: Reject above 325000 spatial vertices or 490000 spatial triangles.
stopRules.aggregateGeometry: Reject above 345000 aggregate vertices or 500000 unique spatial-triangle plus country-line primitives.
stopRules.drawWork: Require 506361 non-checkpoint drawn primitives and six base draw passes; an exact native boundary may add one pass.

integratedGateFullAttempt.disposition: Both failures were corrected before the frozen build; this attempt remains recorded as failure evidence.

focusedRecovery.mutation: Removing the latest-age guard reproduced the stuck waiting state; restoring it returned the regression to pass.
